summary.text: Patty Kim is a Democrat who represents Pennsylvania's 15th Senatorial District, which encompasses lower Dauphin County, after being elected to the Senate in 2024; she previously represented the 103rd District in the state House from 2013 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Before the legislature, Kim was elected to Harrisburg's City Council, where she served two terms and was elected council vice president during her second term.

In the House she chaired the Insurance Committee and earlier the Aging and Older Adult Services Committee, which her biography says made her the first Asian American to chair a Pennsylvania House committee, and she created and was first chair of the Pennsylvania Legislative Asian Pacific American Caucus.
She is a 1995 graduate of Boston College, a member of the board of the United Way of the Capital Region, and is married to John; they have two children.
